Title / Description: Login to eSuite with valid secure credentials
Precondition: eSuite is reachable; ESUITE_EMAIL and ESUITE_PASSWORD are set in the environment; no existing storage_state is required.
Test Steps: 1. Open https://esuite.edot.id; 2. Click Use Email or Username; 3. Enter ESUITE_EMAIL; 4. Submit email; 5. Enter ESUITE_PASSWORD; 6. Submit password; 7. Wait for eDOT Account Center redirect and return to eSuite.
Test Data (exact values): Target URL=https://esuite.edot.id; ESUITE_EMAIL=<secure environment value>; ESUITE_PASSWORD=<secure environment value>
Expected Result: Dashboard is displayed after redirect and greeting text Welcome Back, is visible.

Title / Description: Register Company Step 1 keeps Next disabled until required dependent data is valid
Precondition: User is logged in to eSuite; Register Company wizard is open from Companies to + Add Company.
Test Steps: 1. Leave Step 1 fields blank; 2. Confirm Next is disabled; 3. Select Country only; 4. Confirm downstream mandatory cascade fields remain disabled until their parent value is selected; 5. Fill all required Step 1 fields in order: Country, Province, City/District, District/Commune, Sub District/Village; 6. Confirm Postal Code is auto-populated from the selected village/sub-district; 7. Confirm Next becomes enabled only after all required values are complete.
Test Data (exact values): Company Name=PT Nusantara Ritel Mandiri QA ${RUN_ID}; Email=qa${RUN_ID}@qa.test; Phone=81234567890; Industry Type=Retail; Company Type=Retailer; Language=English; Street Address=Jl. Sudirman No. 10; Country=Indonesia; Province=DKI Jakarta; City/District=Jakarta Selatan; District/Commune=Kebayoran Baru; Sub District/Village=Senayan; Postal Code=12190
Expected Result: Before parent cascade values are selected, mandatory dependent fields are disabled and Next remains disabled. After the cascade is completed in order, Postal Code may remain read-only but must show the expected auto-filled value, and Next must become enabled.

Title / Description: Create a new company with AI-generated Indonesian business data
Precondition: User is logged in to eSuite with reusable storage_state; no company exists for current RUN_ID.
Test Steps: 1. Open Companies; 2. Click + Add Company; 3. Complete Step 1 with validated AI company data or deterministic fallback data; 4. Continue through optional Step 2; 5. Complete Step 3 Branch Name; 6. Click Fill in with the same data from the Company records; 7. Check terms checkbox; 8. Submit registration; 9. Open Companies to Manage and search exact Company Name.
Test Data (exact values): Company Name=PT Nusantara Ritel Mandiri QA ${RUN_ID}; Email=qa${RUN_ID}@qa.test; Phone=81234567890; Industry Type=Retail; Company Type=Retailer; Language=English; Street Address=Jl. Sudirman No. 10; Country=Indonesia; Province=DKI Jakarta; City=Jakarta Selatan; District=Kebayoran Baru; Zone/Sub District=Senayan; Postal Code=12190; Branch Name=Main; Terms and Conditions=checked
Expected Result: Company registration completes, and Companies Manage search results contain one company matching the exact Company Name for current RUN_ID. Success toast alone is not sufficient.

Title / Description: Verify created company detail matches submitted values field by field
Precondition: Company from WEB-TC-003 exists and its exact input data is available from the test run.
Test Steps: 1. Open Companies; 2. Open Manage; 3. Search exact Company Name; 4. Open company detail; 5. Compare every required detail field with the submitted value.
Test Data (exact values): Company Name=PT Nusantara Ritel Mandiri QA ${RUN_ID}; Email=qa.company+${RUN_ID}@example.test; Phone=+6281234567890; Industry Type=Retail; Company Type=Retailer; Street Address=Jl. Sudirman No. 10; Postal Code=12190
Expected Result: Detail view values equal submitted values for name, industry type, company type, address, postal code, email, and phone.

Title / Description: Login to eWork SFA using newly created company credentials
Precondition: eWork SFA is installed; emulator or device is visible in adb devices; mobile credentials are supplied through environment variables; prefer company created by web run.
Test Steps: 1. Launch eWork SFA; 2. Run reusable login flow; 3. Enter EWORK_COMPANY_ID; 4. Enter EWORK_USERNAME; 5. Enter EWORK_PASSWORD; 6. Submit login.
Test Data (exact values): EWORK_COMPANY_ID=<company created by web run>; EWORK_USERNAME=<secure environment value>; EWORK_PASSWORD=<secure environment value>
Expected Result: Mobile dashboard is displayed after login.

Test Data (exact values): Customer Name=Budi Santoso QA ${RUN_ID}; Contact=+6281299900111; Address=Jl. Melati Raya No. 8, Kebayoran Baru, Jakarta Selatan 12190
